headline: Gold Prices Nearing Bottom as World Gold Council Sees Recovery Signals
summary: The World Gold Council's analysis of historical bear markets indicates improving prospects for gold prices, though a complete washout in speculative positions remains necessary.
why: The World Gold Council provides industry insights that help investors gauge sentiment and long-term valuation trends for precious metals in global portfolios.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Recovery signals from the World Gold Council suggest a potential bottoming out for gold prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
